exact_generation_prompt:
Create ONE original sharp realistic premium editorial haircut photograph, NOT a collage, contact sheet, sprite or illustration. The person is a fictional ADULT. HEAD AND SHOULDERS only: complete top of head, all main hair edges, ears and entire haircut silhouette visible, with clear breathing room above the crown and generous margin at both sides. No close crop, no torso emphasis. LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Render at genuine original native resolution supported by this tool, preferably at least1024pixels long edge. No enlargement or upscaling. a fictional adult Black woman with warm dark skin and brown eyes, age 35, wearing a loose opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK long-sleeved jumper with very loose fabric covering upper chest completely. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Classic bixie haircuts. Design: airy separated | short graduated | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 1-crown-to-front-proportion. Attributes: {"texture": "curly", "strand": "medium", "density": "medium", "length": "medium", "fringe": "wispy", "colour": "copper", "finish": "natural", "age_reference": "adult", "face_reference": "unspecified", "maintenance": "discuss"}. Neutral warm stone setting, natural skin, soft studio daylight, full head/hair/ears/nape visible without crop. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
FINAL FRAMING: exceptionally loose fully opaque tall turtleneck collar reaches to directly beneath the jawline, no neck or shoulder skin, no chest contours. Photograph includes only head and shoulder line with ample background all around hair; no midriff or waist. Medium-length bob-pixie hybrid has cropped graduated nape and longer ear-level side shape, distinct from a full bob. All hair in sharp focus.
